free_parameters.name: upgrade_nsize
free_parameters.why: default FlexPosit upgrade width; the target guard reads only bits and base_nsize

free_parameters.name: es
free_parameters.why: lowest legal exponent size for the tiny base_nsize; the target guard does not read es

free_parameters.name: model_width
free_parameters.why: one 4x4 Linear layer is enough for quantizable_layers to yield a layer; the guard does not depend on the width

free_parameters.name: sensitivity
free_parameters.why: one sensitivity row for the single layer so the positive run completes the planning path below the target

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed and an explicitly written weight tensor keep the CPU run deterministic
